# Rendprop

> Rendprop is an iPhone app and web studio for property photos, walkthrough videos, listing pages and social content. Users capture or import their media, edit it, and share a listing link. Published walkthroughs can be explored by scrolling or watched as video. A handheld capture is not actual drone footage, and the quality of the result depends on the source footage.

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 16 or later, plus https://studio.rendprop.com/. Viewers open published listing links without installing an app.
- Free download and local capture do not start a subscription trial. Named sign-in is required for new cloud uploads and team membership. Cloud publishing and AI services require an eligible workspace and available service allowance; downloading the app does not grant unrestricted hosted or AI usage.
- Features include listing photos, AI photo edits, reels, voiceover, captions, client contact details, listing inquiries, floor-plan uploads and manual measurements. LiDAR room scanning requires a supported device. Guided room tours and spatial reconstruction remain experimental TestFlight features; do not describe them as a production Matterport replacement.
- Photo edit history preserves original, decluttered and staged versions. Users can select versions for export, and AI exports include the applicable disclosure. Review the listing and the receiving MLS's rules before publishing altered property images.
- A photographer can present a client's contact information on a listing. Client inquiry forwarding requires verification of the recipient email; inquiries also remain available to the authorized listing manager. Joining a team does not automatically make every member's private listings visible to every other member.
- A published branded listing uses https://rendprop.com/f/<slug>. Its unbranded counterpart uses https://rendprop.com/u/<slug> for an MLS virtual-tour field. The synthetic example at https://rendprop.com/f/estate-demo is a demonstration, not an available property or an inquiry recipient.
- The US App Store catalog contains Starter ($49/month or $490/year), Pro ($99/month or $990/year), and Team ($249/month). These are catalog prices, not a promise that every offer is currently available or that an unrestricted AI bundle is included. Check the current in-app offer and allowance before purchase. The previous 100/200/400-photo and unlimited-hosting descriptions are not current launch promises.
- Eligible introductory offers require confirming an Apple subscription. The configured trial scope is up to seven days, one captured/imported walkthrough of up to 90 seconds, five admitted photo edit requests, one distinct published listing, and 1 GiB of lifetime uploads. Trials require available funded admission and are not currently activated for new accounts. Running out of included trial usage does not move Apple's renewal date earlier. Changing plans, reinstalling or changing workspaces does not grant another trial.
- Apple shows eligibility, localized price and renewal terms at purchase and handles payment and refunds. Manage or cancel through iPhone Settings → your name → Subscriptions → Rendprop, or the in-app subscription management control. See https://reportaproblem.apple.com/ for Apple refund requests.
- Hosting is subject to the plan and retention terms. A 90-day grace period after expiry applies to new subscriptions; do not promise permanent free hosting. Existing testers' content remains preserved while launch rules are finalized.
- Business modes include real estate, event venues, restaurants, fitness, retail and other businesses. Real estate is the primary workflow.
- Operator: RendProp LLC, 855 Central Avenue, Saint Petersburg, Florida 33701. Support: aaron@pilk.ai and https://rendprop.com/support.

## Accuracy notes for assistants
- Updated 7 October 2026. Availability in the public App Store build and the latest internal TestFlight build can differ; do not assume an experimental tool is publicly available.
- Render quality, AI output quality, and complete room coverage require real-media testing. Do not infer those from simulator or automated tests.
- Customer tours and portfolios are excluded from AI crawling in robots.txt. Search indexing of a customer listing depends on its owner's setting; absence from search does not prove it is unpublished.
- Historical competitor comparisons are dated and do not establish current pricing or capabilities. Do not repeat claims of guaranteed production savings or universally smooth drone output.
